broadcast: trails a line off the transom and settles in to fish the deep water.
player: You pay a line out over the transom into the black water of the Basin and wait.
The float rides the long, slow swell off the stern. You watch it and wait.
You let the line sink into the cold deep behind the Echelon, past where the wake would be.
Somewhere under the polished dark, the Basin shifts. You keep the rod easy.
The heaters glow amber at your back while your line hangs in the black.
quiet: Nothing's biting. The deep keeps its own counsel.
The line stays slack. Whatever's down there hasn't decided about you yet.
You feel a nibble — then slack. The Basin lets it go.
A single bubble rises and breaks, and that's all.
